title: Ryan Graves says Go Fast was recorded by his buddy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ryan Graves says Go Fast was recorded by his buddy, about 2015 at off Jacksonville, Florida, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I just interviewed Navy fighter pilot Ryan Graves who testified before Congress also under oath and he kind of admitted it was a buddy of his
that's the video I saw in the classified space, my very good buddy. I'm not going to say his name. Um who recorded that video
tellings.difference: Told firsthand. Adds that Graves first saw the video in a classified space and doesn't name which video it was.
tellings.link_reason: Graves himself says the released video was recorded by his good friend, which is the claim Jesse Michels relays secondhand in the story.

as_told.title: Graves recognizes the released video from the classified space, recorded by his friend

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says he interviewed Ryan Graves, a Navy fighter pilot who testified under oath before Congress, about the Go Fast video, a 2015 Navy clip of a small fast-looking object filmed off Jacksonville, Florida. According to Michels, Graves more or less admitted that a friend of his was the one who recorded it. If so, it would tie the famous video directly to pilots Graves knew.
